result.text:
MASTER PARTICIPATING FACILITY AGREEMENT
This Master Participating Facility Agreement is made on the 17th day of February, 2023 between Cobalt
Mutual Health and Northgate Family Physicians.

1. DEFINITIONS
"Effective Date" means February 17, 2023. "Clean Claim" means a claim that can be processed without
obtaining additional information from the Provider. "Medicare Fee Schedule" means the applicable CMS fee
schedule in effect on the date of service. "Plan" means Cobalt Mutual Health. "Facility" means Northgate
Family Physicians.

2. TERM
2.1 The term of this Agreement begins on the Effective Date and ends on 16 Feb 2027, unless sooner
terminated.
2.2 This Agreement does not renew automatically. Continuation after the expiration date requires a signed
written amendment.
2.3 Either party may terminate this Agreement without cause by giving 60 days written notice.

3. COMPENSATION
3.1 Acute inpatient services shall be reimbursed at a per diem of $2,875.
3.2 General outpatient services shall be reimbursed at 150% of the Medicare Fee Schedule.

4. CLAIMS
4.1 The Plan shall pay each Clean Claim within 45 days of receipt. 4.2 The Facility shall submit claims
within 90 days of the date of service.

5. CREDENTIALING
5.1 The Plan shall complete credentialing within 90 days of a complete application.

6. GENERAL
6.1 This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Washington.
Confidentiality. Each party shall keep the financial terms of this Agreement confidential and shall disclose
them only as required by law.
Insurance. Provider shall maintain professional liability insurance of not less than $2,000,000 per
occurrence.
Records. Each party shall retain records relating to services for 10 years following the date of service.
Disputes. The parties shall attempt in good faith to resolve any dispute through informal negotiation for up
to 45 days before pursuing other remedies.

AMENDMENT NO. 1
Effective February 17, 2024, the parties amend Sections 3.1 and 3.2 of the Agreement as set out below. All
other terms remain unchanged.
Section 3.1 is deleted and replaced with: "Acute inpatient services shall be reimbursed at a per diem of
$3,125."
Section 3.2 is deleted and replaced with: "General outpatient services shall be reimbursed at 160% of the
Medicare Fee Schedule."
